verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a dedicated developer API platform covering cards, transactions, expense data, boletos, and one-click sync/export to NetSuite/QuickBooks/Xero, with OAuth2/mTLS auth and webhooks — directly supporting viewing/managing accounting data via API. However, probes show the OpenAPI/llms.txt spec files 404, so there's no verifiable machine-readable spec, and evidence lacks concrete accounting-specific read/write endpoints (e.g., ledger entries, GL sync detail) beyond transaction/card data. Missing for 10: verifiable OpenAPI spec, explicit accounting-ledger CRUD endpoints, independent developer corroboration.
